alerts.description:

with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 5 to 8 ft expected. For the
Gale Watch, south winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
waves 7 to 12 ft possible.

Sheboygan.

Tuesday morning.

capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
